profile.headline: AI @ Workday | MSCS @ Georgia Tech
profile.summary:
Graduate from the University of California, Irvine with a Bachelor's in Software Engineering and a double minor in Business Management and Digital Art. Looking for any and all SWE opportunities that are centered around cutting-edge technology, social good, or community empowerment.

Currently pursuing a Masters in Computer Science at Georgia Tech with a specialization in Machine Learning.

positions.title: Product Manager, iOS Developer
positions.description:
• Designed Fan360 from scratch, a mobile platform where users can unlock exclusive access to their favorite sports/entertainment celebrities through a tiered-subscription model. Launched on Apple TestFlight.

• Lead a cross-functional team of developers and designers by creating a product roadmap, conducting SCRUM, making budget-driven decisions, and meeting with stakeholders.

• Conceptualized the UI using wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes via Sketch and iterated by collecting consumer feedback.

• Implemented login authentication, dashboards, payment gateways, and messaging systems using APIs, SwiftUI, and Firebase.

positions.title: Space Systems Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Obtained a DoD Secret Security Clearance. Processed for a Top Secret Clearance.

• Built modular widgets that allowed users to remotely configure test sets, visualize real-time spacecraft telemetry parameters, and monitor server health using Vue.js.

• YOLO - Parsed binary files transmitting at 2.5Gb/s and created a filter to sort and demultiplex ethernet packets in only one pass.

• Validated satellite payloads by ensuring byte counts were being captured as expected in order to measure the performance of various network interface cards in C and Linux.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a complete overhaul of the financial aid system interface and enterprise web application that serves over 7,000 graduate students and handles millions of dollars in funding per year.

• Designed management tools using React and Bootstrap to meet web accessibility standards and support assistive technologies.

• Implemented funding calculations, forms, flags, and grant tables with RESTful web services such as Spring, Redux, and JPA to communicate the UI to the Microsoft SQL Server database.

• Automated 300,000+ SQL scripts to populate the entire database with realistic and accurate sample data for developers to test with.

• Rendered API Blueprints via Aglio to keep documentation up-to-date, accurate, 
and cross-functional for both front-end and back-end developers.

• Worked in a highly agile scrum environment that required constant communication with business analysts, product managers, developers, and QA for successful completion of projects via iterative coding sprints.

positions.title: CARAGE · Hackathon Winner - "Best Google Cloud Platform Hack"
positions.description:
• Tracked which parking spots were filled via a continuous aerial view from a GoPro camera by applying Google's Cloud Vision API Tesseract OCR combined with the WatchService + Watchdog API.

• Collected statistics on duration parked and lot density based on time patterns in order to extrapolate data into MySQL/Firebase and visualize vacancy trends into Tableau/dynamic web application.

• Business insight on which lots are popular and at which times in order to adjust the sales of parking permits and event reservations.

• Consumer insight on helping students find vacant parking in real-time in order to remove obstacles towards learning and customer dissatisfaction.

projects.title: Parking Structure Monitor
projects.description:
➟ Applied Google's Cloud Vision API in order to track which parking spots were filled via a continuous aerial view from a GoPro camera.

➟ Collected statistics on duration parked, usage based on time patterns, and vacancy trends in order to extrapolate data into Excel. Used a combination of VLOOKUP queries, visual basic macros, and math functions in order to visualize data and interpret specific trends in parking.

➟ Potential to receive University funding to build a complete prototype with the hopes of widespread deployment across all campus parking lots/structures. Gives useful insight on which lots are popular and at which times in order to adjust the sales of parking permits and event reservations. Could also be implemented into a mobile application to help students find vacant parking in real-time. 

➟ Developed a deep understanding of file management and how to combine various API's to communicate seamlessly with each other as well as an interest in computer vision, image/video signal processing, and deep learning.

projects.title: QuakeUp
projects.description:
➟ Collaborative engineering project developed from scratch with the goal of building an alarm clock-like mattress.

➟ Operated extensively on the Arduino Uno and used C++ in order to trigger approximately 60 vibration motors connected to a breadboard and DIY  pressure sensors built using velostat (electrically conductive polymeric foil infused with carbon).

➟ Worked in a team of 3 software-focused members to collaborate with 13 other students from various engineering disciplines with the sole purpose of creating something fun and original in order to gain exposure to the integration of hardware and software. 

➟ Learned how to effectively communicate on a project with such an expansive amount of unfamiliar factors and people through agile development and a focus on accountability and leadership.
